summary.description: Spring Boot application for asset management with file upload, storage, and thumbnail generation capabilities

incidents.title: AWS S3Client usage in AwsS3Service

incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob Storage BlobServiceClient

incidents.title: S3 ListObjectsV2 operation
incidents.description: AWS S3 list objects operation needs Azure equivalent
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobContainerClient.listBlobs()

incidents.description: AWS S3 put object operation needs Azure equivalent
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobClient.upload()

incidents.title: S3 GetObject operation
incidents.description: AWS S3 get object operation needs Azure equivalent
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobClient.downloadContent()

incidents.title: S3 DeleteObject operation
incidents.description: AWS S3 delete object operation needs Azure equivalent
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobClient.delete()

tasks.task: Migrate from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus
Migrate from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage - Web Module
Migrate from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage - Worker Module

recommendations: Use Azure Managed Identity for all Azure service authentication to eliminate credential management
Leverage Spring Cloud Azure starters for simplified Azure service integration
Implement Azure Application Insights for comprehensive monitoring and diagnostics
Consider using Azure Key Vault for managing application secrets
Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.4.x and Java 21 LTS before migration for better Azure support
Use Azure Service Bus JMS integration for minimal code changes from RabbitMQ
Test migration in non-production environments before production deployment
Implement proper error handling and retry logic for Azure services
Consider using Azure Container Apps or Azure Spring Apps for deployment
Set up CI/CD pipeline with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for automated deployments
